answer: The system issues a cryptographic plume token that only avatars who have logged a recent orchard‑style contribution can claim, linking identity to a verifiable resource event. To register, the avatar co‑signs a time‑locked vault transaction bearing a glacier‑scale proof‑of‑work stamp shared by all members of that kin‑linked group, so a Sybil attacker must produce a fresh plume, forge orchard data and solve a separate glacier‑size work puzzle for every fake identity, raising the cost linearly with the number of bots.
